data.title: O'Neill Cylinders: Building Cities in Space With Gravity
data.snippet: TL;DR: O'Neill cylinders are massive rotating space habitats that could house thousands using artificial gravity from centrifugal force. While technically feasible based on physics and NASA studies from the 1970s, building these kilometer-scale structures faces immense challenges in cost, materials, and construction that advancing space technology is gradually making more achievable.
